limits_state: PLANNED, NOT APPLIED. A separate reviewed supervisor must enforce and record actual host limits and high-water observations before this adapter is eligible.
layer: real-process-WebSocket; two separately observed runtime processes, no required cross-VM placement
scope: Ordinary credential-free public JS WebSocket API in active coordinator fetch and regular nonhibernating upgraded connections; fixed owned private peer only.
excluded: No retained stateless capability, pool retirement/lifetime reproduction, hibernation, malformed wire frames, raw frame injection, authentication, forgery, replay, abrupt process/network faults, unbounded producer, public destination, deployment, runtime launch or build.
os_relevance: Cloudflare OS uses Cap'n Web over WebSockets. These synthetic application messages exercise the native transport beneath that use; they do not exercise Cap'n Web RPC semantics or an unchanged OS workflow.
runner: private_driver.py is import-only and request-only; no command-line execution, provisioning, deployment, kill, memory tuning or fault injection. Missing review/ownership/limits/placement/cleanup evidence blocks before network.
